title: T7 · Cap. 14 · Editar a OS em campo (narração 132,2 s; marcas L1..L10 = início de cada linha do roteiro)

setup.js: (async()=>{const el=([...document.querySelectorAll("main *")].find(e=>e.children.length===0&&e.textContent.trim()==="Checklists"));if(!el)return 'SEM ALVO';const r=el.getBoundingClientRect();const cy=r.top+r.height/2;const y0=window.scrollY,dy=Math.round(cy-(300));if(Math.abs(dy)<3)return 'ok';const dur=Math.min(1000,Math.max(450,Math.abs(dy)*1.15)),t0=performance.now();await new Promise(res=>{const f=t=>{const p=Math.min(1,(t-t0)/dur),e=p<.5?2*p*p:1-Math.pow(-2*p+2,2)/2;window.scrollTo({top:y0+dy*e,behavior:'instant'});p<1?requestAnimationFrame(f):res()};requestAnimationFrame(f)});return Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().top)})()
